title: Loop+ Membership Benefits Guide: Delivery, Streaming, Grocery and Deals
content:
Loop+ Membership plans carry the same shopping and entertainment benefits on every plan, with one difference in the Loop+ Music entitlement. This guide lists each benefit for all six plans.

## Delivery and grocery

| Plan | Free Two-Day delivery on eligible items | Member Same-Day pricing | Grocery subtotal at or above which grocery delivery is free (USD) | Grocery delivery fee below the minimum (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | included | applies | 35.00 | 9.95 |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | included | applies | 35.00 | 9.95 |
| Loop+ Student Annual | included | applies | 35.00 | 9.95 |
| Loop+ Monthly | included | applies | 35.00 | 9.95 |
| Loop+ Annual | included | applies | 35.00 | 9.95 |
| Loop+ Household Annual | included | applies | 35.00 | 9.95 |

## Streaming, photos and deals

| Plan | Loop+ Video | Loop+ Music entitlement | Unlimited full-resolution photo storage | Early access to Lightning Deals (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | included | individual | included | 30 |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | included | individual | included | 30 |
| Loop+ Student Annual | included | individual | included | 30 |
| Loop+ Monthly | included | individual | included | 30 |
| Loop+ Annual | included | individual | included | 30 |
| Loop+ Household Annual | included | family | included | 30 |

## What each benefit means

- **Two-Day delivery**: whether Two-Day delivery on eligible items is free; free on every plan.
- **Same-Day delivery**: whether member Same-Day pricing applies; it applies on every plan.
- **Loop+ Video**: whether Loop+ Video is included; included on every plan.
- **Loop+ Music**: the Loop+ Music entitlement; the individual tier on every plan except Loop+ Household Annual, which carries the family tier.
- **Photo storage**: whether unlimited full-resolution photo storage is included; included on every plan.
- **Grocery delivery**: grocery delivery is free when the grocery subtotal is at or above 35.00; below that minimum the grocery delivery fee is 9.95.
- **Lightning Deals**: members get 30 minutes of early access to Lightning Deals.

## Grocery delivery, worked on hypothetical baskets

| Hypothetical grocery subtotal (USD) | At or above the 35.00 minimum? | Grocery delivery fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 35.00 | yes, equal to the minimum | none |
| 34.99 | no | 9.95 |
| 52.40 | yes | none |
